title: More Ways To Craft Sugar
description: More Ways To Craft Sugar — a Minecraft mod that adds new sugar recipes using sweet berries, glow berries, and beetroot.
body:
This mod expands the ways you can craft sugar in Minecraft, allowing you to produce it not only from sugar cane but also from other sweet ingredients found throughout the world.

🍓 New Recipes:
Sweet Berries → Sugar  
Use 3 sweet berries to craft 2 units of sugar. Perfect for forest biomes!

Glow Berries → Sugar  
3 glow berries yield 2 sugar. Great for cave explorers and lush biomes.

Beetroot → Sugar  
3 beetroots convert into 1 sugar. A practical use for your farm harvest!

📦 Why Use It:
Simplifies survival in biomes without sugar cane

Makes farming more rewarding

Adds realism and variety to crafting
